description: Suggest the Nice classes (1-45) a goods/services description falls under, with reasons. Read-only, pure reasoning — no live data, no register lookup. Input goodsDescription is what you sell (e.g. 'music streaming app'); the more specific it is, the better the classes. Returns JSON with the suggested classes (each with its label), the classes assumed from your wording, and the reasons. Use before filing to pick classes (each class costs $350 to file), or to feed classes into screen_trademark / check_global_marks. Always verify against the USPTO ID Manual for the exact pre-approved description.

goodsDescription.description: What you sell, e.g. 'music streaming app' or 'coffee shop' — the more specific, the better the class suggestions
